verdict.rationale: Google Cloud can be automated without a UI. The scriptable gcloud CLI covers auth, config and API interactions, there are REST APIs and client libraries for automating workflows, and Infrastructure Manager offers declarative Terraform deployments with previews. Workload Identity Federation also lets external workloads such as CI runners authenticate without service account keys. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-interactive/headless CLI usage or CI-pipeline integrations (e.g., CI runner setup), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
